arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== FADEGO_ACTIVE_RELEASE ==="
p=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value fadego-staging.service)
echo "main_pid=$p"
if test "$p" -gt 1 2>/dev/null; then
 sudo -n readlink /proc/"$p"/cwd || :
 sudo -n ps -o pid,ppid,comm -p "$p"
fi
echo "=== FADEGO_ALL_RELEASES ==="
sudo -n find /srv/fadego-staging/releases -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | sort
echo "=== FADEGO_LINK_SHARED_SAMPLE ==="
sudo -n find /srv/fadego-staging/releases -xdev -type f -links +1 -printf '%n %p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -8 || :
echo "=== ANDROID_RUNNING ==="
sudo -n ps -eo pid,comm,etime,args --no-headers | grep -E '[/](emulator|qemu-system|gradle-daemon)' | cut -c 1-150 || :
echo "=== PROJECT_TIMERS ==="
systemctl --no-pager --no-legend list-timers --all | grep -Ei 'lowcost|fadego|pink|telegr|project|backup' | head -22 || :
echo "=== GRAPHIC_APPS_APT_MANUAL ==="
a=$(apt-mark showmanual)
for p in blender krita gimp kdenlive openshot-qt qgis inkscape darktable audacity obs-studio synfigstudio scribus calibre freecad librecad openscad ansible pandoc libreoffice dotnet-sdk-10.0; do
 if dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'install ok installed'; then
  if printf '%s\n' "$a" | grep -qxF "$p"; then echo "$p|manual"; else echo "$p|auto"; fi
 fi
done
echo "=== DONE ==="
